text: Happy 4th Anniversary to THE OFF SEASON!!! I can't believe it's been 4 years already, take me back please. I have so many memories of this song I first heard this song in May 2021. I was 12 when this song came out and I was playing football in Paterson, NJ even though I lived in the Northwestern part of the state like Sparta, NJ. This song will always take me back to summer 2021, I remember when I was training this song would be playing and I would be hyped. I never liked football, and I hated my dad for making me play since 2019, but I stopped playing in 2022 because my mom told him no more football because I hated it. I heard this song from April 2021 to December 2021. The other time I heard this song was when my mom, my sister, and I were going to Georgia to see my cousins it was so much fun, we went in July 2021, so three years ago this week from July 22, 2021, to July 31, 2021. I can't believe that was three years ago, this song will forever remind me of training, working out, playing football, going on the Georgia vacation, and listening to this song with my dad on the radio in the car. My dad and I were so obsessed with this song, time went by way too fast for 2021 to be 3 years ago. text: I have so many memories of this song I first heard this song in May 2021. I was 12 when this song came out and I was playing football in Paterson, NJ even though I lived in the Northwestern part of the state like Sparta, NJ. This song will always take me back to summer 2021, I remember when I was training this song would be playing and I would be hyped. I never liked football, and I hated my dad for making me play since 2019, but I stopped playing in 2022 because my mom told him no more football because I hated it. I heard this song from April 2021 to December 2021. The other time I heard this song was when my mom, my sister, and I were going to Georgia to see my cousins it was so much fun, we went in July 2021, so three years ago this week from July 22, 2021, to July 31, 2021. I can't believe that was three years ago, this song will forever remind me of training, working out, playing football, going on the Georgia vacation, and listening to this song with my dad on the radio in the car. My dad and I were so obsessed with this song, time went by way too fast for 2021 to be 3 years ago. I wish I could go back, J Cole's Off-Season album, Drake's Certified Lover Boy album, and Pop Smoke's song What You Know 'Bout Love (R.I.P) all bring back memories of that summer and summer 2022. In summer 2022 we went on so many vacations, in April 2022, we went to Outer Banks and Richmond, VA, then in May 2022, we went to Aruba, in June 2022, we went to Barbados, and in July 2022, we went to Orlando with my cousins from Georgia to celebrate my other aunt's 10th anniversary on July 1, 2012 - July 1, 2022.

text: Happy 5th Anniversary to THE OFF SEASON!!! I can't believe it's been 5 years already, take me back please. I have so many memories of this song I first heard this song in May 2021. I was 12 when this song came out and I was playing football in Paterson, NJ even though I lived in the Northwestern part of the state like Sparta, NJ. This song will always take me back to summer 2021, I remember when I was training this song would be playing and I would be hyped. I never liked football, and I hated my dad for making me play since 2019, but I stopped playing in 2022 because my mom told him no more football because I hated it. I heard this song from April 2021 to December 2021. The other time I heard this song was when my mom, my sister, and I were going to Georgia to see my cousins it was so much fun, we went in July 2021, so three years ago this week from July 22, 2021, to July 31, 2021. I can't believe that was three years ago, this song will forever remind me of training, working out, playing football, going on the Georgia vacation, and listening to this song with my dad on the radio in the car. My dad and I were so obsessed with this song, time went by way too fast for 2021 to be 4 - 5 years ago. I wish I could go back, J Cole's Off-Season album, Drake's Certified Lover Boy album, and Pop Smoke's song What You Know 'Bout Love (R.I.P) all bring back memories of that summer and summer 2022. In summer 2022 we went on so many vacations, in April 2022, we went to Outer Banks and Richmond, VA, then in May 2022, we went to Aruba, in June 2022, we went to Barbados, and in July 2022, we went to Orlando with my cousins from Georgia to celebrate my other aunt's 10th anniversary on July 1, 2012 - July 1, 2022. This will forever remind me of the summers of 2021 and 2022. I wish I could go back to those years. I miss the early 2020s sometimes. Even though Covid-19 was around, I still made the most of my life, and I hope we can all do that in the future. May 14, 2021 - May 14, 2026.

text: Happy 4th Anniversary to THE OFF SEASON!!! I can't believe it's been 4 years already, take me back please. I have so many memories of this song I first heard this song in May 2021. I was 12 when this song came out and I was playing football in Paterson, NJ even though I lived in the Northwestern part of the state like Sparta, NJ. This song will always take me back to summer 2021, I remember when I was training this song would be playing and I would be hyped. I never liked football, and I hated my dad for making me play since 2019, but I stopped playing in 2022 because my mom told him no more football because I hated it. I heard this song from April 2021 to December 2021. The other time I heard this song was when my mom, my sister, and I were going to Georgia to see my cousins it was so much fun, we went in July 2021, so three years ago this week from July 22, 2021, to July 31, 2021. I can't believe that was three years ago, this song will forever remind me of training, working out, playing football, going on the Georgia vacation, and listening to this song with my dad on the radio in the car. My dad and I were so obsessed with this song, time went by way too fast for 2021 to be 3 years ago. text: I have so many memories of this song I first heard this song in May 2021. I was 12 when this song came out and I was playing football in Paterson, NJ even though I lived in the Northwestern part of the state like Sparta, NJ. This song will always take me back to summer 2021, I remember when I was training this song would be playing and I would be hyped. I never liked football, and I hated my dad for making me play since 2019, but I stopped playing in 2022 because my mom told him no more football because I hated it. I heard this song from April 2021 to December 2021. The other time I heard this song was when my mom, my sister, and I were going to Georgia to see my cousins it was so much fun, we went in July 2021, so three years ago this week from July 22, 2021, to July 31, 2021. I can't believe that was three years ago, this song will forever remind me of training, working out, playing football, going on the Georgia vacation, and listening to this song with my dad on the radio in the car. My dad and I were so obsessed with this song, time went by way too fast for 2021 to be 3 years ago. I wish I could go back, J Cole's Off-Season album, Drake's Certified Lover Boy album, and Pop Smoke's song What You Know 'Bout Love (R.I.P) all bring back memories of that summer and summer 2022. In summer 2022 we went on so many vacations, in April 2022, we went to Outer Banks and Richmond, VA, then in May 2022, we went to Aruba, in June 2022, we went to Barbados, and in July 2022, we went to Orlando with my cousins from Georgia to celebrate my other aunt's 10th anniversary on July 1, 2012 - July 1, 2022.
